title: Apple CEO sends strong warning on AI and price of Apple products
excerpt: Tim Cook spent part of July 30 thanking Apple shareholders at the end of what he confirmed would be his last earnings call as CEO. John Ternus takes over Sep...
content_html:
Tim Cook spent part of July 30 thanking Apple shareholders at the end of what he confirmed would be his last earnings call as CEO. John Ternus takes over Sept. 1, and Cook moves to executive chairman.

The farewell was warm. The statement that followed was not.

Cook described Apple's memory cost situation as a "100-year flood," language he said he has never used in more than 40 years in the consumer electronics industry.

Apple has already raised prices on Macs and iPads. It expects memory costs to climb further in the current quarter. And it warned that supply constraints will affect iPhone, Mac, and iPad sales in September, Yahoo Finance reported.

What Tim Cook said about memory prices on Apple's Q3 2026 earnings call

Cook's exact words on the call: "On the pricing front, you know, we reluctantly raised prices. I would say we did it because we're in what I would characterize as a 100-year flood on memory pricing with exponential increases in memory prices, so that was the rationale for it."

Apple's Q3 2026 numbers came in ahead of estimates. Earnings per share were $2.02 against a $1.89 consensus. Revenue was $109.4 billion versus the $108.8 billion estimate. iPhone revenue hit $54.2 billion, above the $53.5 billion projection.

More Apple:

  • Apple stock move vindicates Palantir CEO warning for AI industry

  • Apple's iPhone cost problem reveals AI's hidden bill

  • Apple's 2027 hardware refresh sends Wall Street a warning

But the memory issue dominated the call. CFO Kevan Parekh said that without rising memory costs, Apple's gross margins would have been materially stronger.

Memory accounted for more than the entire sequential decline in adjusted gross margin between the March and June quarters, Benzinga reported. Cook confirmed Apple has paid rising memory costs for three consecutive quarters.

Why memory prices are driving Apple to raise prices on its products

The memory cost surge is driven by AI data-center demand. Companies including Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta have been buying high-bandwidth memory and advanced DRAM at a pace that has overwhelmed supply.

SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron, the three companies that control the global DRAM market, have largely sold out their premium AI memory capacity through much of 2026. A federal class-action antitrust lawsuit filed in California in June 2026 accuses all three of coordinating a supply restriction that drove conventional DRAM prices up approximately 700% over four years, Rain Intelligence noted, though those claims have not been proven in court.

content_html_zh:
蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 在 7 月 30 日的部分时间里感谢了苹果股东，他确认这将是他作为首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议。 约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 于 9 月 1 日接任，库克则担任执行董事长。

告别是温暖的。 随后的声明并非如此。

库克将苹果的内存成本状况描述为“100年洪水”，他说他在消费电子行业40多年来从未使用过这种语言。

苹果已经提高了 Mac 和 iPad 的价格。 它预计本季度内存成本将进一步攀升。 据雅虎财经报道，该公司警告称，供应限制将影响 iPhone、Mac 和 iPad 9 月份的销售。

蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 在苹果 2026 年第三季度财报电话会议上对内存价格的看法

库克在电话会议上的原话是：“在定价方面，你知道，我们不情愿地提高了价格。 我想说我们这样做是因为我们正处于内存价格的 100 年洪水中，内存价格呈指数级增长，所以这就是这样做的理由。”

苹果 2026 年第三季度的数据超出了预期。 每股收益为 2.02 美元，市场预期为 1.89 美元。 收入为 1,094 亿美元，而预期为 1,088 亿美元。 iPhone 收入达到 542 亿美元，高于预期的 535 亿美元。

更多苹果：

  • 苹果股价走势证明 Palantir 首席执行官对人工智能行业的警告是正确的
  • 苹果 iPhone 成本问题揭示 AI 隐藏账单
  • 苹果 2027 年硬件更新向华尔街发出警告

但内存问题主导了这次通话。 首席财务官 Kevan Parekh 表示，如果内存成本不上涨，苹果的毛利率将会大幅提高。

据 Benzinga 报道，内存在 3 月至 6 月季度调整后毛利率环比下降中的占比更大。 库克证实，苹果已连续三个季度支付不断上涨的内存成本。

为什么内存价格上涨促使苹果提高其产品价格

内存成本激增是由人工智能数据中心需求推动的。 Nvidia、微软、亚马逊和 Meta 等公司一直在以超出供应的速度购买高带宽内存和先进 DRAM。

控制全球 DRAM 市场的 SK 海力士、三星和美光这三家公司在 2026 年的大部分时间里已经基本售空了他们的优质 AI 内存容量。 Rain Intelligence 指出，2026 年 6 月在加利福尼亚州提起的联邦集体反垄断诉讼指控三人协调供应限制，导致传统 DRAM 价格在四年内上涨约 700%，尽管这些指控尚未在法庭上得到证实。
